release: unreleased performance candidate; original audit stage used installed 1.2.5/r38

findings.cause: Unchanged applications remeasure every member name and identity mark.
findings.repair: Reuse current-batch geometry until member identity, displayed name, marks, columns, font tuple or effective scale changes; release inactive records.

findings.cause: One member change triggers native measurements for unchanged members.
findings.repair: Retain current member scalar inputs and comment metrics; clear released entries and invalidate font/scale inputs.

counter.fixture: one changed member in a warmed five-member list

findings.cause: Result notifications repeatedly lay out a closed filter panel.
findings.repair: Opening resolves complete geometry; visible notifications relayout only changed summary or error visibility.

findings.cause: Same-frame equipment and specialization notifications rebuild the roster synchronously.
findings.repair: One zero-delay display notification; explicit Get remains current, prune and inspect cancellation remain synchronous.
Temporary exact identity set over all 11 normalized fields; preserve original winner, sort and malformed data handling.
findings.complexity: dedup O(P); complete initialization including unchanged sorting O(P log P)

findings.cause: Repeated fixed rules rewrite unchanged native fonts, artwork and anchors and allocate temporary state.
findings.repair: Read current native state, retain bounded declared-slot inputs, honor explicit derived font fields and ownership, avoid steady temporary patches.

counter.fixture: 100 controls with two declared slots; 10000 stable Apply calls

findings.cause: Geometry scratch keys keep released business objects reachable.
findings.repair: Clear scratch keys after geometry calculation, Clear and return to fixed row heights.

findings.cause: Hidden application sync builds full group details to find the first explicitly flagged leader.
findings.repair: Independent strict leader scalar cache with lazy details; preserve missing-flag and first-flag semantics.

findings.cause: Editing one note reason scans every stored record for sidebar counts.
findings.repair: Compute four counts at bind and update them with actual mutations; no per-record type snapshot.

findings.cause: Every application layout invalidates unchanged caption metrics.
findings.repair: One displayed-frame settle on enter/font changes; reuse stable metrics and cancel pending settle on leave/hide.

counter.fixture: 100 stable layouts after each display/font settling phase

findings.cause: Permanent per-controller hooks retain released controllers and continue invoking them.
findings.repair: One dispatcher per source/event with removable active subscriptions; clear snapshots on normal, nested and failed delivery.

findings.cause: Each request generates the same talent import string before the existing send throttle.
findings.repair: Retail-only current config/spec/string reuse for automatic responses; synchronous invalidation and fresh public reads. Keep minor 28 and provider selection.

counter.fixture: 40 unchanged requests in one frame or 1.95 seconds

findings.scope: applies only when this embedded minor 28 supplies the shared library

findings.cause: Product Bind duplicates constructor tracking; adjacent hover/pressed clears repeatedly apply the same controller.
findings.repair: Remove two redundant bindings, preserve custom card binding, and combine only adjacent contributions from the same controller/source.

findings.cause: Five Notes navigation buttons duplicate constructor hover tracking.
findings.repair: Keep the navigationStyle alias and selected state, remove its redundant hover Bind.

counter.fixture: 240 hover/leave events on each of five Notes tabs

findings.cause: Repeated ClosePicker calls restore an already identical unconfirmed choice and rebuild the hidden activity list.
findings.repair: Restore only a changed or pending confirmed choice; keep real cancellation after hiding/leaving. Apply fixed rules at the actual filter control layout boundary.

counter.fixture: 20 filter open/close cycles with an already closed activity picker

findings.cause: Each entry rewrites an already identical native font during natural-width calculation.
findings.repair: Six scalars retain the latest successful font request and native readback; preserve each label measurement, instance fonts and failed retries.

findings.cause: Changing font or size rebuilds an already hidden activity picker after leaving Find.
findings.repair: Refresh visible picker geometry only outside the closing transition; retain complete content refresh on opening, live catalog/rating updates and draft cancellation.

counter.fixture: 20 font size changes after leaving Find; two fixture activities

findings.cause: A caller-retained Row or Column controller keeps cachedItems after Release, retaining descriptors from its final Layout.
findings.repair: Clear the cached item array and cache-valid flag while releasing existing layout ownership and registration.

counter.fixture: 20 released Row controllers with 50 valid descriptors each; controllers deliberately retained

findings.scope: Public layout Release contract; current product layouts are permanent and do not call Release.

findings.cause: Repeated SetItems plus Measure retains obsolete descriptors and records until Layout or Release runs.
findings.repair: Update the current record index on every run; after Measure retain only current items and records for placements still owned by the controller.

counter.fixture: 20 batches of 50 public descriptors using a prebuilt native Frame pool

findings.scope: Public Row/Column Measure API; current product does not use measurement-only controllers. Existing placement anchors remain owned until Layout or Release.

native.scope: Private contexts and owned objects; candidate library loaded into isolated Lua namespace; caption uses a private product namespace with installed library.
native.memoryPolicy: natural GC; no new four-package production memory-budget measurement
native.interpretation: Compare isolated r38 and candidate fixed-list batch timings. They are not full-frame FPS or total addon CPU. Setter counts describe only probe-owned objects.

separateObservation.status: pre-existing first-hover behavior retained; outside performance repair scope
separateObservation.detail: The alpha and color transitions share a Motion key and the first hover color job cancels the alpha job. First-hover cancellation is also present in the pre-audit r38 snapshot. r40 and r41 have identical observed output over a 252-record comparison; this does not claim complete r38/r41 trajectory equality. Reduced-motion endpoints pass their intended alpha checks.

excludedExperiment.reason: Extra request/readback caching reduced setter counts but did not demonstrate elapsed-time benefit in native 100- and 1000-candidate comparisons. Revision 44 restored Layouts.lua byte-for-byte to r42. Later r45/r46 repairs change layout record cleanup; the text measurement cache prototype remains withdrawn.

delivery.scope: original audit stage, before the subsequent user-requested r46 deployment and live validation

followUp.note: Original audit-stage deployment and private-context measurements above retain their original scope.
